title: Describe your routine
goal: Describe a typical weekday and your weekend in a short connected text and a 45-second talk.

blocks.title: Ma semaine et ma fin de semaine
blocks.fr:
Je m'appelle Amira. J'ai 34 ans et je suis marocaine. J'habite à Moncton avec mon mari et mes deux enfants.
En semaine, je me lève à 6 h 30. Je me douche, je m'habille et je réveille les enfants. À 7 h 45, ils vont à l'école et je vais au travail. Je travaille dans une banque : je commence à 8 h 30 et je termine à 16 h 30.
Le soir, je fais la cuisine et nous mangeons à 18 heures. Les enfants se couchent à 20 heures. Moi, je me couche toujours à 22 heures.
La fin de semaine, c'est différent ! Le samedi, je fais la grasse matinée : je me lève à 9 heures. Mon mari et moi, nous faisons l'épicerie et le ménage. Le dimanche, nous allons au parc ou nous restons à la maison. Je fais du sport une fois par semaine, le dimanche matin. Et je ne travaille jamais la fin de semaine !
blocks.en:
My name is Amira. I'm 34 and I'm Moroccan. I live in Moncton with my husband and my two children.
During the week, I get up at 6:30. I shower, I get dressed and I wake the children up. At 7:45, they go to school and I go to work. I work in a bank: I start at 8:30 and I finish at 4:30.
In the evening, I do the cooking and we eat at 6. The children go to bed at 8. Me, I always go to bed at 10.
The weekend is different! On Saturdays, I sleep in: I get up at 9. My husband and I do the grocery shopping and the housework. On Sundays, we go to the park or we stay home. I exercise once a week, on Sunday mornings. And I never work on weekends!

blocks.title: A voice message from Alex
blocks.context: Alex, a friend from Toronto, answers Amira: what is his week like?
blocks.fr: Salut Amira ! C'est Alex. Moi, en semaine, je travaille le soir, dans un restaurant. Alors je me lève tard, à 10 heures. Je commence à 16 heures et je rentre à minuit. Le week-end, je ne travaille jamais : je me repose et je vais souvent au cinéma avec mes amis. Bonne fin de semaine !
blocks.en: Hi Amira! It's Alex. During the week, I work in the evening, in a restaurant. So I get up late, at 10. I start at 4 p.m. and I get home at midnight. On weekends, I never work: I rest and I often go to the movies with my friends. Have a good weekend!

blocks.body: This lesson brings the whole unit together: -er verbs, reflexive verbs, frequency words, [[faire]] and [[aller]]. Read Amira's text once for the general idea, then a second time to spot each type of verb.

blocks.title: Weekday or weekend?
blocks.body:
To compare your week and your weekend, start each part with a clear time frame:

- [[En semaine]] = during the week (Monday to Friday)
- [[Le week-end]] or [[la fin de semaine]] = on weekends
- [[D'habitude]] = usually

Then use [[mais]] or [[c'est différent]] to show the contrast: [[En semaine, je me lève tôt, mais le week-end, je fais la grasse matinée.]]

blocks.title: Time first, then the action
blocks.note: Starting with the time phrase makes your text easy to follow. Put a comma after it.

examples.fr: En semaine, je me lève à 6 heures.
examples.en: During the week, I get up at 6.

examples.fr: Le soir, nous mangeons souvent à 19 heures.
examples.en: In the evening, we often eat at 7.

examples.fr: Le samedi, je fais les courses.
examples.en: On Saturdays, I do the shopping.

examples.fr: Le dimanche, je ne travaille jamais.

blocks.title: Jour or journée?
blocks.body:
Both mean *day*, but they look at it differently:

- [[un jour]] counts days or names a day: [[tous les jours]], [[trois jours]], [[Quel jour on est ?]]
- [[la journée]] is the day **as a stretch of time**, from morning to evening: [[ma journée typique]], [[toute la journée]] (all day long).

That is why people say [[Bonne journée !]] when you leave a shop: *have a good (whole) day!* The same pattern exists with [[le soir]] / [[la soirée]] and [[le matin]] / [[la matinée]], which is where [[la grasse matinée]] comes from: literally *the fat morning*.

blocks.title: Bonne fin de semaine !
blocks.body:
On a Friday afternoon in Montréal, Québec City or Moncton, you will hear [[Bonne fin de semaine !]] everywhere: at work, in shops, at school. In France, people say [[Bon week-end !]]

Notice also that Amira, who lives in New Brunswick, writes [[nous faisons l'épicerie]] (see Lesson 5.4): the usual way in Québec and much of French-speaking Canada to say *we do the grocery shopping*. In France: [[nous faisons les courses]].

blocks.title: Upgrade your text
blocks.body:
Before you write, check that your text has:

- one **nous** form ([[nous mangeons]], [[nous faisons]], [[nous nous levons]])
- one reflexive verb with **m'** or **s'** ([[je m'habille]], [[il s'habille]])
- one **ne… jamais** sentence
- one contrast with **mais**
- one **au** or **aux** ([[au travail]], [[aux cours]])

Five boxes ticked? Your text is ready for the checkpoint.

blocks.fr: Salut Amira ! C'est Alex. Moi, en semaine, je travaille le soir, dans un restaurant. Alors je me lève tard, à 10 heures. Je commence à 16 heures et je rentre à minuit.
blocks.en: Hi Amira! It's Alex. During the week, I work in the evening, in a restaurant. So I get up late, at 10. I start at 4 p.m. and I get home at midnight.
blocks.prompt: What time does Alex get up during the week?
blocks.explain: [[je me lève tard, à 10 heures]]. He starts work at 16 heures (4 p.m.).

blocks.fr: Le week-end, je ne travaille jamais : je me repose et je vais souvent au cinéma avec mes amis.
blocks.en: On weekends, I never work: I rest and I often go to the movies with my friends.
blocks.prompt: What does Alex do on weekends?
options: He rests and goes to the movies.
blocks.explain: [[je ne travaille jamais]] = I never work; [[je me repose]] = I rest; [[je vais au cinéma]] = I go to the movies.

blocks.prompt: At your French class, the teacher asks: “Votre journée typique, c'est comment ?” (What is your typical day like?) Talk for about 45 seconds about a typical weekday and your weekend.
checklist: En semaine: get up, go to work or class, get home, go to bed
Le week-end: two activities with faire or aller
One frequency word (souvent, toujours, ne… jamais)

models.label: Model answer
models.fr: Bonjour ! Je suis Sofia. D'habitude, en semaine, je me réveille à 7 heures. Le matin, je vais aux cours de français et l'après-midi, je travaille. Je rentre à 19 heures et je mange avec ma fille. Le week-end, c'est différent : je fais la grasse matinée, je fais le ménage et nous allons souvent au parc. Le dimanche soir, je me couche tôt.
models.en: Hello! I'm Sofia. Usually, during the week, I wake up at 7. In the morning, I go to French classes and in the afternoon, I work. I get home at 7 p.m. and I eat with my daughter. On weekends, it's different: I sleep in, I do the housework and we often go to the park. On Sunday evenings, I go to bed early.

summary:
- Describe a typical weekday with times, -er verbs, reflexive verbs, [[faire]] and [[aller]]
- Contrast it with the weekend using [[en semaine]], [[le week-end / la fin de semaine]] and [[mais]]
- Say how often you do things, including [[ne… jamais]], in a 60–90 word text and a 45-second talk
